create_model_type_enum: create a ModelType enum to select from cogvideox, cogview4, flux, hunyuan_video, ltx_video, or wan
create_training_type_enum: create a TrainingType enum to select from lora, full-finetune, control-lora, or control-full-finetune
get_model_specification_cls: get the ModelSpecification class for a given model name and training type combination
list_supported_model_configs: list all supported model and training type configurations from SUPPORTED_MODEL_CONFIGS
validate_model_training_combination: validate that a model name and training type combination is supported before proceeding
